newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker buyers sidelined, offers too high.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker buyers sidelined, offers too high.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Tuesday were steady although sellers, anticipating a further rise in the cargo market, were unwilling to sell at current levels, traders said.
A shipowner said the he planned to cover his requirements in Colombo as prices were more competitive. Another said he planned to postpone his buying until December as current offers were too high.
Bunker 180-cst were quoted at $130 and 380-cst at $125 by both majors and independents. MDO were steady at $222-$226 and gasoil at around $235-$242. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
